searchText: <@277500722655002624> Unfortunately cant write on the interop channel so I reply here 🙂 what exaclty are you interested in? searching for EL block number or hash? Hi <@808969530608451584> ! I need to check by number, but ability to check by hash sounds useful too I could probably add both.. The values are there. just needs an index on db side and some small ui changes.. However, will only be possible for post-bellatrix blocks (but I guess that's fine for devnets) Sorry in advance if this is crossposting or wrong channel or what not but wanted to get any input on this PR for 4844 to clarify the serialization of blob transactions submitted via RPC (`eth_sendRawTransaction` specifically). https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7530 It was originally discussed here https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/804019759934078987/1143297503412891822 but wanted to make sure I get the right input on it. Does it warrant discussion on either the Dencun or ACD-E calls? I've found another way, I'm looking parent beacon block root and than choosing next beacon blocks, which is quite usable Also added both (search for EL block number & hash) to the explorer 🙂 But it's not in the EF hosted instance yet. It's already in here: https://beaconlight-devnet8.pk910.de/ Works like a charm. Thank you! Will the countdown to fork be based on a TTD like the merge did? No, it will be a specific timestamp. Probably on a CL epoch. TTD was only for the merge. Shanghai proved the viability of the timestamp based fork.
